```{r}

d <- read.csv("C:/Users/hlamp/OneDrive/IndependentResearch/hlamp13.github.io/projects/MLB26/full_mlb_stats_with_position.csv")

head(d)

```


```{r}

retired_d <- d %>% filter(Active..1.0. == 0)

bat_vars <- d[, c("tot_WAR", "Years", "bat_ASG", "bat_AB", "bat_H", "bat_HR", "bat_RBI", "bat_SB", "bat_BB", "bat_SO", "bat_BA", "bat_OBP", "bat_SLG", "bat_OPS")]
pit_vars <- d[, c("tot_WAR", "Years", "pit_ASG", "pit_W", "pit_L", "ERA_x", "pit_G", "pit_IP", "pit_H", "pit_BB", "pit_SO")]

summary(
  d[
    , c("HOF..1.0.", "tot_WAR", "Years", "bat_H", "bat_HR", "bat_RBI", "bat_BB", "bat_SO", "ERA_x", "pit_IP", "pit_BB", "pit_SO")
  ]
)

summary(
  retired_d[
    , c("HOF..1.0.", "tot_WAR", "Years")
  ]
)

```


## Linear Model
```{r}

linear_model <- lm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years,
  data = retired_d
)

summary(linear_model)

```


## Testing for correlation

```{r}

cor(bat_vars, use = "complete.obs")

cor(pit_vars, use = "complete.obs")

```
## Testing different models. All will include tot_WAR, Years, ASG. (Potential to not include ASG in future)
### Pitching: ERA, SO, W, L
### 6 Models:
### - BASE
### - ERA
### - ERA, SO
### - ERA, W
### - ERA, L
### - L

### Batting: HR, SB, BA, OBP, SLG, OPS, RBI, BB, H
### 12 Models:
### - BASE
### - HR
### - HR, SB
### - BA
### - OBP
### - SLG
### - OPS
### - BA, HR
### - RBI
### - RBI, SB
### - BB
### - H

```{r}

retired_bat_d <- retired_d %>% filter(primary_pos %in% c("C", "1B", "2B", "3B", "SS", "OF"))
retired_pit_d <- retired_d %>% filter(primary_pos %in% c("P"))

```

```{r}

base_pit <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years,
  data = retired_pit_d, family = binomial
)

era_pit <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + ERA_x,
  data = retired_pit_d, family = binomial
)

era_so_pit <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + ERA_x + pit_SO,
  data = retired_pit_d, family = binomial
)

era_W_pit <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + ERA_x + pit_W,
  data = retired_pit_d, family = binomial
)

era_L_pit <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + ERA_x + pit_L,
  data = retired_pit_d, family = binomial
)

L_pit <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + pit_L,
  data = retired_pit_d, family = binomial
)

```


```{r}

AIC(base_pit, era_pit, era_so_pit, era_W_pit, era_L_pit, L_pit)

```


```{r}

base_bat <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years,
  data = retired_bat_d, family = binomial
)

HR_bat <- glm(

)

HR_SB_bat <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + bat_HR + bat_SB,
  data = retired_bat_d, family = binomial
)

)

)

BA_HR_bat <- glm(

  data = retired_bat_d, family = binomial
)

RBI_bat <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + bat_RBI,
```

```{r}

AIC(base_bat, HR_bat, HR_SB_bat, BA_bat, OBP_bat, SLG_bat, OPS_bat, BA_HR_bat, RBI_bat, RBI_SB_bat, BB_bat, H_bat)

```

### FULL RETIRED DATASET

```{r}

base_model <- glm(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years,
  data = retired_d, family = binomial
)

stargazer(base_model, type = "text")

```


```{r}

random_int <- glmer(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + (1|primary_pos),
  data = retired_d, family = binomial  
)

random_slope <- glmer(
  HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR + Years + (tot_WAR|primary_pos),
  data = retired_d, family = binomial
)

AIC(random_int, random_slope)
ranef(random_slope)

```


```{r}

war_C <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["C", "tot_WAR"]

war_1B <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["1B", "tot_WAR"]

war_2B <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["2B", "tot_WAR"]

war_3B <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["3B", "tot_WAR"]

war_SS <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["SS", "tot_WAR"]

war_OF <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["OF", "tot_WAR"]

war_P <- fixef(random_slope)["tot_WAR"] +
  ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos["P", "tot_WAR"]

```

```{r}

tot_effects <- data.frame(
  Position = c("C", "1B", "2B", "3B", "SS", "OF", "P"),
  LogOdds = c(war_C, war_1B, war_2B, war_3B, war_SS, war_OF, war_P),
  OddsRatio = c(exp(war_C), exp(war_1B), exp(war_2B), exp(war_3B), exp(war_SS), exp(war_OF), exp(war_P))
)

tot_effects

```

```{r}

re <- ranef(random_slope)$primary_pos

re_df <- data.frame(
  pos = rownames(re),
  slope = re[, "tot_WAR"]
)

ggplot(re_df, aes(x = reorder(pos, slope), y = slope)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Random WAR Effect by Position with Years",
    x = "Position",
    y = "WAR Slope Adjustment"
  )

```

## Shrinkage

```{r}

by(retired_d, retired_d$primary_pos,
   function(d) glm(HOF..1.0. ~ tot_WAR, family=binomial, data=d))

```



```{r}

avg_war <- retired_d %>%
  group_by(primary_pos) %>%
  summarize(avg_war = mean(tot_WAR, na.rm = TRUE))

avg_war

colnames(avg_war)[colnames(avg_war) == "primary_pos"] <- "Position"

plot_df <- merge(avg_war, tot_effects_2, by = "Position")

plot_df


```
